subject: Merchant portal: payment account connect / POs not visible
messages:
From: Katie Morgan <katie.morgan@metroaero.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ed Park <ed.park@metroaero.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access to supplier portal — connected bank/account not showing POs

Hi Jordan / Ben,

Thanks again for sending the onboarding invite last week. We accepted the Workday supplier portal link this morning but two issues are blocking us from starting to reconcile POs:

- After claiming the account, MetroAero can see the profile but there are no active POs listed under "Purchase Orders" — it shows "No records found" even though Procurement has already issued a PO (PO-4729).
- When Ed tries to connect our payment account (ACH), the link redirects to an authentication page and then returns an error: "Session could not be established. Please try again." (screenshot attached).

We tried from Chrome and Edge, and also cleared cookies with no luck. Can you check whether the tenant mapping or any account linking step failed on your side? We need to confirm the PO visibility so accounting can match invoices.

Attaching screenshot of the redirect page.

Thanks,
Katie Morgan
Head of Finance Operations
MetroAero Inc.
Attachment: screenshot_portal_dashboard.png
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access to supplier portal — connected bank/account not showing POs

Hi Katie — thanks for the details and the screenshot.

I'm sorry you're seeing that. A couple quick clarifying Qs so we can route this properly:

1) Can you confirm the tenant ID you landed on after claiming the invite? (there's a short id in the URL, looks like t-xxxx)
2) Is the PO number you expect (PO-4729) visible to any other users at MetroAero, or is it missing for everyone?
3) If you have a network trace or the full error text from the auth page that would help — the screenshot is useful but the server-side log will show why the session didn't persist.

Ben, I'm looping you and Marissa in — could you check whether the claim flow completed for MetroAero in our onboarding logs and whether the PO import job for their customer account succeeded this morning?

Katie — we'll treat this as high priority. If it's helpful we can schedule a quick 20-minute screen-share to repro with your team this afternoon. What time window works for you?

Best,

Jordan Blake
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Katie — quick update from the onboarding ops side after I reviewed the logs and ran a repro:

- The account claim did complete, but our PO ingestion job failed on a vendor ID mismatch during the morning ingest window. That's why the "Purchase Orders" tab returned empty. We've queued a re-import for PO feed stream (job id import-20270928-77).
- The payment connect redirect error looks like a SameSite cookie regression for the Workday auth flow — the browser drops the session when the redirect crosses domains. Engineering confirmed this is the same regression we've seen in older browser versions when third-party cookies are restricted.

Workarounds for MetroAero right now:
- Use an incognito window and try the payment connect flow (some customers report success).
- If that fails, Ben temporarily created a direct bank-link token I can send privately; that bypasses the hosted connect flow (expires in 24 hours).

I've opened internal ticket RI-5421 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-5421) to patch the cookie flag and ensure our redirect sets SameSite=None; Secure. Engineering will also run the PO re-import and validate that PO-4729 is present. I'll follow up once both items are confirmed.

Proposed action: if you're available at 16:00 PT today we can do a quick screen-share and I can test the incognito flow with you and, if needed, inject the temporary bank-link token. Please let me know.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Onboarding & Integrations
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
